title: Titanium PEEK-Insulated Hybrid Bolt
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium PEEK-Insulated Hybrid Bolt where the combination of high strength (830 MPa yield), low weight (4.43 g/cm³), and atmospheric corrosion immunity justifies the material upgrade from carbon or stainless steel. The alpha-beta microstructure is readily machinable at 30-50 SFM with carbide tooling and produces a stable oxide that requires no painting or plating in indoor/outdoor service — ideal for PEEK-insulated titanium hybrid smart screw. This rationale is driven by peek-insulated titanium hybrid smart screw and service environment demands.
process: CNC turning and boring for fastener geometry
surfaceTreatment: Passivation per ASTM B600 followed by hot DI water rinse 70C minimum to prevent flash rust on finished surfaces — tailored for peekinsulated titanium hybrid application
commonFailures: Galvanic corrosion at dissimilar interfaces — critical for peekinsulated titanium hybrid performance

faq.q: What standard dimensional tolerances apply to Titanium PEEK-Insulated Hybrid Bolt?
faq.a: Titanium PEEK-Insulated Hybrid Bolt is manufactured to ISO 2768-m medium tolerances (±0.1 mm for basic dimensions up to 30 mm, ±0.2 mm for 30-120 mm). Functional mating surfaces can be held to ±0.025 mm with Ra 0.8 µm surface finish. For peekinsulated titanium hybrid, specific tolerance classes can be quoted based on functional requirements.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium PEEK-Insulated Hybrid Bolt orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium PEEK-Insulated Hybrid Bolt is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium PEEK-Insulated Hybrid Bolt?
faq.a: Each Titanium PEEK-Insulated Hybrid Bolt shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for peekinsulated titanium hybrid.
